messages:
Maya (growth): Quick sync — we're iterating hero + subhead for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Need 3 distinct headline variants per product and a single, shared supporting line for the top funnel. Also want to embed a webinar CTA and make sure inbound leads route to Sales correctly. Can people drop quick suggestions?
Alex (content): For Hosted: "Instant LLM inference, zero ops". Subhead: "Start building with predictable latency and friendly pricing."
Chris (design): +1 clean. For Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity for production SLAs". Sub: "Throughput you can commit to, performance you can trust." Thinking background: subtle cluster illustration.
Devon (ops): For Private page we should lead with security: "On-prem & VPC deployments for regulated workloads". Sub: "Control your data, keys, and network." Also we need a short bullets list for KMS/HSM, audit logs, and air-gapped options.
Sam (demand): Inbound routing note: any webinar signups should create a lead in Salesforce with product_interest = Hosted/Dedicated/Private and tag = webinar-march. Can we add a hidden field on CTA forms?
Tara (PM): Agree on hidden fields. Also we should avoid overly technical phrasing in hero for hosted — keep it product-friendly. For Dedicated/Private call out SLAs + compliance.
Alex (content): Draft compact shared supporting line: "High-performance LLM inference tailored to how you deploy — hosted, reserved, or private." Open to tightening.
Chris (design): CTA sequencing idea: Primary CTA = Try Hosted (fast path), Secondary = Talk to Sales (for Dedicated/Private). For Private page: Primary = Contact Sales, Secondary = Explore Tech Docs.
Maya (growth): Love that. Also want an experiment: on the Dedicated page, test a small benchmark blurb showing p95 latency and cost per 1k tok for a sample config. Would that be misleading?
Devon (ops): Benchmarks okay if we include hardware and model caveats. Eg: "p95: 180ms on A100 for 512 tokens (approx) — your mileage will vary." Legal ok with that if we add a short disclaimer.
Tara (PM): Let's keep a standard benchmark template and a toggle in the CMS so we can enable region/model-specific numbers later.
Sam (demand): Webinar: "Scaling inference in production" — landing needs: 1) register form (product_interest), 2) UTM tracking, 3) follow-up email templates that route to AE based on product_interest. I can own the AE routing map.
Alex (content): Two alternative hero heads for Hosted to test: 
```
1) "Build fast with a production-first LLM API"
2) "Ship features powered by fast, predictable inference"
```
Which feels less marketingy?
Chris (design): #2 feels more outcome-focused. Also propose microcopy under signup: "No credit card for dev keys" if we keep free tier.
Maya (growth): Good. For Private page we should add a short line about procurement: "Enterprise licensing & on-prem packages available — contact sales for procurement timelines."
Devon (ops): Also add: "Supports KMS/HSM and SOC2-ready audit trails" — short bullet.
Alex (content): I'll assemble a one-pager with all the variants by EOD. Will include the 3x headlines per product, 3 supporting lines, and CTA permutations.
Tara (PM): Timeline: we want to push microsite copy to staging by Friday so growth can QA the webinar funnel.
Maya (growth): Okay — owners: Alex (copy), Chris (visuals), Devon (benchmarks/compliance copy), Sam (lead routing + webinar). I'll queue a task for Engineering to add hidden form fields — @deploy-bot can you link the staging form endpoint and open a deploy ticket?
deploy-bot: Created ticket #DEVOPS-4217 and linked staging form: https://staging.redwood.ai/forms/webinar-register — will need CORS config.
Chris (design): One last UX ask: for Dedicated page, include an ROI line near CTA: "Estimate your per-request cost based on throughput" with a calculator link.
Sam (demand): I'll work with Growth to spec the calculator inputs.
Maya (growth): Perfect. Alex, drop the one-pager in this thread when ready and tag people for final signoff. Small copy A/B tests: hero variant + CTA label + benchmark blurb on Dedicated. We should track conversion and SQL rate by product_interest tag.
Alex (content): Will do. Posting draft in ~4 hours.
Tara (PM): Thanks all — moving to tasks.
Maya (growth): :rocket:
